note: Analyst reading of the news, written by the weekly agent from logged events. Not data. Replace every week.
headline: Talks are back on through go-betweens: VP Vance sent Iran's security chief a letter (delivered Oct 25) proposing a meeting led by Vance, with Iran's nuclear program on the table (#129). Qatari mediators took a draft to Tehran on Oct 30, and Qatari and Pakistani mediators held indirect talks with an Iranian delegation in Doha on Oct 30-Nov 1 (#133, #139). No deal yet.

Trump's no-strike pledge runs out with the Nov 3 midterms. The US reportedly told Gulf allies to get ready for a short, intense campaign after them (#130), and Trump says 'one or two' targets are left; on Nov 1 he said 'Either they'll make a deal, or we'll just end it' (#137). Rubio says no decision has been made.

Iran's Supreme Leader warned any new attack would get an 'immediate' and 'geographically unrestricted' response; FM Araghchi says there are no plans to meet US officials until the US meets Iran's conditions (#138).

Shipping: UKMTO reported projectile hits on ships on Oct 29, Oct 30 (south of Lavan) and Nov 1; Oman rescued 25 crew from a burning tanker off Musandam, and a Qatari LNG carrier was attacked (#132, #134, #135, #136, #140). No injuries were reported. The IRGC claims more ships hit mines.
No US strike on Iran, no Iranian attack on US forces, and no new US sanctions were found this week. CENTCOM says the blockade has turned back 144 ships (#137).
